record.one_liner: GitHub offers a fully described OpenAPI-compliant REST API supporting personal access tokens for authentication.

auth_methods.quote: You can use a personal access token in place of a password when authenticating to GitHub in the command line or with the API.

access_test.quote: In the left sidebar, under Personal access tokens , click Fine-grained tokens . Click Generate new token .

access_ship.quote: In the left sidebar, under Personal access tokens , click Fine-grained tokens . Click Generate new token .

api_type.quote: The GitHub REST API is fully described in an OpenAPI compliant document.

api_breadth.quote: Create integrations, retrieve data, and automate your workflows with the GitHub REST API.
